chunks: Al-Sakūnī narrated with his chain of transmission; he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

key_terms.الرَّفِيقَ: the companion or fellow traveler to be chosen first
key_terms.السَّفَرَ: the journey or travel undertaken afterward
key_terms.السَّكُونِيُّ: Al-Sakūnī, the narrator transmitting this report
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "First the companion, then the journey" mean?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that one should first consider the suitability of a travel companion before undertaking a journey. It highlights the importance of companionship, prudence, and mutual support in travel.
